PROPERTY_ID

ERM-P046

PROPERTY_NAME

Backup existence as proof that recovery is solved

HISTORICAL_ORIGIN

Backup and contingency-plan compliance.

LINEAGE_CLASS

  1. AVAILABILITY_AND_REPAIRABLE_SYSTEMS_LINEAGE

  2. SERVICE_RELIABILITY_OR_SRE_TRANSLATION

RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS

  1. MAINTAINABILITY_NATIVE

  2. SERVICE_RELIABILITY_TRANSLATION

ORIGINAL_FORM

Verify that backup jobs run and copies exist.

PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED

Preserve data/artefacts for loss scenarios.

REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION

Restored, authoritative and functionally usable state within RPO/RTO—not copy existence.

FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT

Stale/corrupt/inaccessible/incompatible backup; missing key/tool; incomplete application state; same disaster affects source; restore never tested.

MECHANISM

Reject existence claim; apply ERM-P017 recurring restore/reconstitution validation.

TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT

Never sufficient alone; backup is one precondition in a recovery case.

NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH

For reproducible stateless assets, verify build-from-source and one end-to-end check.

DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS

Integrity, freshness, isolation, tooling, configuration, capacity, procedures, state semantics and trained staff.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS

A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS

A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS

No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.

DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS

Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS

A valid recovery source, authorised action, state/data reconciliation, dependency readiness and independently checked return-to-service postconditions.

MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS

The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF

Copy existence has potential value only when the complete recovery path is valid.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Data/service owner and continuity authority.

KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES

Green job; empty archive; partial DB; wrong version; inaccessible credentials; unbounded restore time.

IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS

Incident evidence directly refutes the equivalence.

HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED

Backup compliance evolved toward restore exercises, functional validation and reconstitution.

MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM

Use ERM-P017; do not claim recoverability from inventory alone.

CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY

Backup-count dashboard is the ceremony.

Backup existence as proof that recovery is solved

INITIATING_FAULT_OR_FAILURE

Stale/corrupt/inaccessible/incompatible backup; missing key/tool; incomplete application state; same disaster affects source; restore never tested.

LOCAL_EFFECT

Loss, corruption, delay, false indication or degraded performance at the initiating item.

NEXT_LEVEL_EFFECT

Effect on the enclosing function, dependency path or maintenance process.

END_EFFECT

Stale/corrupt/inaccessible/incompatible backup; missing key/tool; incomplete application state; same disaster affects source; restore never tested.

PROPAGATION_PATH

Functional, physical, state, timing, control, resource or organisational coupling.

CONTAINMENT_BOUNDARY

A declared fault-containment region or explicit stop/degradation boundary.

DEPENDENCIES

Integrity, freshness, isolation, tooling, configuration, capacity, procedures, state semantics and trained staff.

COMMON_CAUSE_OR_SHARED_COUPLING

Shared specification, environment, supplier, control plane, state, maintenance or operator path must be challenged.

LATENT_CONDITION

Standby, monitoring, repair or dependency defects may remain latent until demand.

DETECTION

Outcome- or function-relevant observation, not a component heartbeat alone.

CONTROL

Reject existence claim; apply ERM-P017 recurring restore/reconstitution validation.

RESIDUAL_RISK

Unmodelled combinations, dependence, coverage gaps and changed configuration remain.

APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

Backup existence as proof that recovery is solved

INITIATING_FAILURE

Stale/corrupt/inaccessible/incompatible backup; missing key/tool; incomplete application state; same disaster affects source; restore never tested.

RECOVERY_ACTION

Reject existence claim; apply ERM-P017 recurring restore/reconstitution validation.

AUTHORITY_SOURCE

The designated current configuration/state authority and authorised operator or controller.

CHECKPOINT_BACKUP_SPARE_OR_ALTERNATE

Declared checkpoint, replica, backup, spare, rebuild source or manual workaround.

RPO_OR_STATE_LOSS_BOUND

Explicit allowed state/data loss or “none” for state-continuous functions.

RTO_OR_RESTORATION_BOUND

Explicit time-to-restoration bound including diagnosis, logistics, repair and validation.

STATE_RECONCILIATION

Resolve divergent, stale, partial or replayed state before authoritative service resumes.

FUNCTIONAL_POSTCONDITIONS

Restored, authoritative and functionally usable state within RPO/RTO—not copy existence.

DATA_STATE_POSTCONDITIONS

Integrity, completeness, freshness, ordering and authority appropriate to the mission.

DEPENDENCY_POSTCONDITIONS

Critical dependencies and capacity are verified rather than assumed from local restart.

VALIDATION

Independent end-to-end functional and state checks under representative demand.

RETURN_TO_SERVICE_AUTHORITY

Named human or automated authority with explicit acceptance criteria.

ROLLBACK_OR_FALLBACK

A bounded fallback when restoration validation fails or the original cause persists.

MATURE_FORM

Use ERM-P017; do not claim recoverability from inventory alone.

RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

Backup existence as proof that recovery is solved

CLAIM

Use ERM-P017; do not claim recoverability from inventory alone.

POPULATION_OR_DENOMINATOR

Declared units, missions, demands, requests, users, time windows or recurrent-event process.

CONFIGURATION_IDENTITY

Exact hardware, software, data, model, dependency and procedure versions.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE

Representative demand/workload/environment with consequence-important rare cases identified.

TEST_OR_OBSERVATION_DESIGN

Predeclared sampling/censoring, failure scoring, exposure and stopping rules.

MODEL

Model selected for the stated estimand: life distribution, recurrent-event process, binomial demand, availability state model or direct functional check.

ASSUMPTIONS

Independence, stationarity, censoring, repair effectiveness, acceleration, coverage and representativeness are explicit.

CONFIDENCE_OR_UNCERTAINTY

Intervals, posterior uncertainty or bounded qualitative confidence; point estimates alone are insufficient.

CENSORING_AND_MISSINGNESS

Right/interval censoring, unreported events, lost telemetry and excluded windows are recorded.

COVERAGE

Claim coverage is limited to tested/observed failure modes, environments and paths.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Data/service owner and continuity authority.

CHEAP_PATH

For reproducible stateless assets, verify build-from-source and one end-to-end check.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE

A valid backup is necessary in many recovery strategies, just never sufficient.

EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS

Evidence expires when configuration, profile, environment, support organisation or dependencies materially change.

MATURE_FORM

Use ERM-P017; do not claim recoverability from inventory alone.

DISPOSITION_RATIONALE

Rejected; superseded by tested restore/reconstitution ERM-P017.

current_claim
native_id

ERM-P046

current_id

DRF-L2-C046

disposition

RETAIN_REJECTION_OF_INVENTORY_AS_RECOVERY

reason_codes

  1. ANALYTICAL_REDECOMPOSITION

bearer

A stored backup inventory and a recovery capability claim.

proposition

Backup existence does not entail that required data or function can be recovered under the relevant loss scenario.

guard_quantifier

The invalid implication is rejected. A backup can be valuable evidence of stored state, and a bounded restore demonstration can establish more without proving every disaster.

model_domain

Existence of bytes and restored-function predicates are logically different.

mechanism

Keeps accessibility, trust, compatibility, dependencies and receiving checks visible.

consumer_decision

Test or otherwise substantiate a path, use rebuild, repair the missing resource or accept loss.

positive_scope

Validated backup/rebuild at declared scope underC017.

negative_scope

Inventory-only recovery assurance rejected; no dismissal of untested bytes as necessarily worthless.

counterexample

C04'sinternalrestorationcanholdwhilecredentialandexternalconditionsfail; an encrypted backup without its lost key does not satisfy even the internal restore requirement.

criterion

Follow the chain from available source to required state/function and mark each unobserved premise.

evidence_refs

  1. F008

  2. F043

  3. F017

evidence_ceiling

Primary mechanisms and logical counterexample; native GitLab2017original is not freshly read in this study.

remaining_premises

Recoverable source, permissions, compatible environment, resources, receiving condition and data-loss tolerance.

cheap_path_alternatives

Rebuild reproducible stateless assets and perform a direct function check.

cost_retirement

Retire redundant backups only after checking remaining loss coverage and applicable retention constraints.

audit_question

What evidence beyond possession of bytes establishes the restoration path and its declared result?

cases

PROFILE_TYPE

MISSION_RELIABILITY_PROFILE

FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

Backup existence as proof that recovery is solved

INITIATING_FAULT_OR_FAILURE

Stale/corrupt/inaccessible/incompatible backup; missing key/tool; incomplete application state; same disaster affects source; restore never tested. Current limitation: Inventory-only recovery assurance rejected; no dismissal of untested bytes as necessarily worthless.

LOCAL_EFFECT

Loss, corruption, delay, false indication or degraded performance at the initiating item.

NEXT_LEVEL_EFFECT

Effect on the enclosing function, dependency path or maintenance process.

END_EFFECT

Stale/corrupt/inaccessible/incompatible backup; missing key/tool; incomplete application state; same disaster affects source; restore never tested. Current limitation: Inventory-only recovery assurance rejected; no dismissal of untested bytes as necessarily worthless.

PROPAGATION_PATH

Functional, physical, state, timing, control, resource or organisational coupling.

CONTAINMENT_BOUNDARY

A declared fault-containment region or explicit stop/degradation boundary.

DEPENDENCIES

Recoverable source, permissions, compatible environment, resources, receiving condition and data-loss tolerance.

COMMON_CAUSE_OR_SHARED_COUPLING

Shared specification, environment, supplier, control plane, state, maintenance or operator path must be challenged.

LATENT_CONDITION

Standby, monitoring, repair or dependency defects may remain latent until demand.

DETECTION

Function-relevant observation at the claimed boundary; a component heartbeat can suffice when it directly observes the complete required binary function. It does not establish a wider end-to-end function merely by being green.

CONTROL

Keeps accessibility, trust, compatibility, dependencies and receiving checks visible.

RESIDUAL_RISK

Unmodeled combinations, dependence, observation gaps and changed conditions remain possible. A valid bounded containment contribution need not establish diagnosis or complete restoration.

REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

false

PROFILE_TYPE

REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE

REASON

The property does not itself claim redundancy benefit; any redundant implementation must invoke ERM-P008/ERM-P009.

DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

false

PROFILE_TYPE

DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PROFILE

REASON

The candidate is not a diagnostic claim; outcome observation may still be required by its evidence profile.

RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

Backup existence as proof that recovery is solved

INITIATING_FAILURE

Stale/corrupt/inaccessible/incompatible backup; missing key/tool; incomplete application state; same disaster affects source; restore never tested. Current limitation: Inventory-only recovery assurance rejected; no dismissal of untested bytes as necessarily worthless.

RECOVERY_ACTION

Keeps accessibility, trust, compatibility, dependencies and receiving checks visible.

AUTHORITY_SOURCE

State/configuration identity and the actual authority relevant to the action or claim. A pure model has no external action authority; a bounded internal restore does not by itself establish authority to resume a wider service.

CHECKPOINT_BACKUP_SPARE_OR_ALTERNATE

Declared checkpoint, replica, backup, spare, rebuild source or manual workaround.

RPO_OR_STATE_LOSS_BOUND

State/data loss bound where the function depends on preserved state; explicitly state a nontrigger for stateless or directly reconstructible functions.

RTO_OR_RESTORATION_BOUND

The declared restoration interval or bound, if the claim requires one. Distinguish detection, waiting, logistics, repair and validation and avoid summing overlapping intervals.

STATE_RECONCILIATION

Reconcile the state required by the named restored function. Broader divergent or external state may remain an explicit residual; authoritative wider service requires its own relevant conditions.

FUNCTIONAL_POSTCONDITIONS

Restored, authoritative and functionally usable state within RPO/RTO—not copy existence. Current scope: Validated backup/rebuild at declared scope underC017.

DATA_STATE_POSTCONDITIONS

Integrity, completeness, freshness, ordering and authority appropriate to the mission.

DEPENDENCY_POSTCONDITIONS

Verify dependencies that the particular restoration claim requires. Record unverified external dependencies separately; they prevent an unsupported wider completion claim but do not erase a valid internal postcondition.

VALIDATION

An observation or proof adequate to the named functional/state postcondition. Independent end-to-end checks are appropriate when the claim needs them, not a universal prerequisite for every local deterministic restoration.

RETURN_TO_SERVICE_AUTHORITY

Keep proof of the postcondition separate from actual permission to resume consequential service. Name the relevant decision maker or rule when applicable.

ROLLBACK_OR_FALLBACK

A justified bounded fallback where it adds protection. It need not resolve every root cause, and not every restoration claim requires a second full recovery mechanism.

MATURE_FORM

Backup existence does not entail that required data or function can be recovered under the relevant loss scenario. Guard: The invalid implication is rejected. A backup can be valuable evidence of stored state, and a bounded restore demonstration can establish more without proving every disaster.

RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

Backup existence as proof that recovery is solved

CLAIM

Backup existence does not entail that required data or function can be recovered under the relevant loss scenario. Guard: The invalid implication is rejected. A backup can be valuable evidence of stored state, and a bounded restore demonstration can establish more without proving every disaster.

POPULATION_OR_DENOMINATOR

Declared units, missions, demands, requests, users, time windows or recurrent-event process.

CONFIGURATION_IDENTITY

Identify the hardware, software, data, model, environment, dependency and procedure conditions that the particular claim materially depends on. An exhaustive live inventory is not universally required.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE

Representative demand/workload/environment with consequence-important rare cases identified.

TEST_OR_OBSERVATION_DESIGN

Use a design adequate to the estimand: sampling, censoring, exposure and stopping assumptions for stochastic inference; an exact predicate and finite domain for a deterministic check. Retrospective observations retain their actual design limits.

MODEL

Model selected for the stated estimand: life distribution, recurrent-event process, binomial demand, availability state model or direct functional check.

ASSUMPTIONS

Declare the assumptions actually used, such as independence, stationarity, censoring, repair effectiveness, acceleration, coverage or representativeness. Their absence from an unrelated deterministic claim is not automatically a defect.

CONFIDENCE_OR_UNCERTAINTY

Express uncertainty appropriate to the claim. A stochastic estimate needs its model and uncertainty; an exact deterministic result need not invent a probability interval. A qualitative criterion may remain qualitative.

CENSORING_AND_MISSINGNESS

Right/interval censoring, unreported events, lost telemetry and excluded windows are recorded.

COVERAGE

Empirical inference is limited by the observed population and design; a mathematical or exhaustive finite result can cover its explicitly proved domain. Neither automatically supplies external-system correspondence.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Test or otherwise substantiate a path, use rebuild, repair the missing resource or accept loss.

CHEAP_PATH

Rebuild reproducible stateless assets and perform a direct function check.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE

C04'sinternalrestorationcanholdwhilecredentialandexternalconditionsfail; an encrypted backup without its lost key does not satisfy even the internal restore requirement.

EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS

Reassess evidence when a relevant configuration, profile, environment, support or dependency change alters a premise. No arbitrary periodic expiry or full-retest rule follows for unaffected claims.

MATURE_FORM

Backup existence does not entail that required data or function can be recovered under the relevant loss scenario. Guard: The invalid implication is rejected. A backup can be valuable evidence of stored state, and a bounded restore demonstration can establish more without proving every disaster.

profile_scope

The native applicability classification is retained for this candidate claim. Applicable templates describe claim-specific questions, not a mandatory bundle for every system. Nonapplicable reasons remain exact.

native_record
PROPERTY_ID

ERM-P047

PROPERTY_NAME

One failover test as proof of disaster recovery

HISTORICAL_ORIGIN

High-availability acceptance and disaster-recovery exercises.

LINEAGE_CLASS

  1. AVAILABILITY_AND_REPAIRABLE_SYSTEMS_LINEAGE

  2. SERVICE_RELIABILITY_OR_SRE_TRANSLATION

RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS

  1. FAULT_TOLERANCE_IMPORT_OR_SHARED_ANCESTRY

  2. SERVICE_RELIABILITY_TRANSLATION

ORIGINAL_FORM

Trigger failover once and record that the secondary became active.

PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED

Demonstrate transfer capability.

REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION

Recovery across the relevant disaster/fault population, current configuration, representative state/load and postconditions.

FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT

Only nominal fault; shared control survives; secondary warm; no state divergence; no user journey; no return/failback; stale evidence after change.

MECHANISM

Reject generalisation; maintain scenario/claim coverage, current configuration, correlated faults, load/state, recovery/failback and postcondition evidence.

TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT

A failover test is one evidence item when it discriminates a live claim.

NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH

Directly verify the changed component/path after small changes; reserve full exercises for material uncertainties.

DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS

ERM-P008/009, current state, representative fault/load, independent observability, abort and recovery validation.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS

A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS

A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS

Credible failure-domain independence, common-cause analysis, standby condition, switchover coverage and state compatibility.

DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS

Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS

A valid recovery source, authorised action, state/data reconciliation, dependency readiness and independently checked return-to-service postconditions.

MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS

The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF

A well-designed test supports the tested scenario only.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Continuity/service owner and acceptance authority.

reason_codes

bearer

One finite failover exercise and a broader disaster-recovery claim.

proposition

A failover result supports the conditions and faults it actually challenges; it does not by itself establish all disaster recovery paths.

guard_quantifier

A single test can be sufficient for a narrow deterministic question. Generalization needs a justified fault/profile/configuration relationship, not an arbitrary larger test count.

model_domain

An observed finite result is not a universal quantifier over untested faults.

mechanism

Keeps test coverage, state, load and postconditions attached to the claim.

consumer_decision

Retain the tested claim, narrow a broader one or test a material remaining difference.

positive_scope

One adequate local test and carefully scoped broader exercises.

negative_scope

Universal disaster-recovery inference rejected; no rule that every useful claim needs multiple exercises.

counterexample

A stateless worker failover does not test a corrupt backup, stale authority or shared control-plane outage.

criterion

Map the exercised fault and receiving predicate to the intended claim; identify the concrete untested discriminator.

REDUNDANCY_FORM

Active, standby, voting, diverse, replicated or alternate-path redundancy as explicitly declared.

CLAIMED_TOLERANCE

The specified number/class of faults tolerated while meeting required function or an accepted degraded state.

FAILURE_DOMAINS

Physical, power, network, control-plane, state, software, supplier, operator and maintenance domains.

INDEPENDENCE_EVIDENCE

Address actual shared causes and the joint event law. Statistical independence is required only by formulas or claims that use it; dependent paths may still provide a positive rescue increment. Copy count or labels alone do not establish separation.

COMMON_CAUSE_COUPLINGS

Specification, design, implementation, environment, supplier, maintenance, configuration and operational coupling.

STANDBY_LATENCY_OR_DORMANCY

Dormant faults, activation delay and cold/warm/hot readiness are measured when applicable.

STATE_CONSISTENCY

The takeover state and authority must be current, complete and semantically valid.

DEGRADED_MODE

Declared reduced capability and exit conditions.

TEST_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE

Evidence appropriate to the stated protection claim, including a direct deterministic result or a model at its exact premises where adequate. A general architecture or field-rate claim needs correspondingly broader evidence; no universal live-test or field-study bundle is imposed.

MATURE_FORM

A failover result supports the conditions and faults it actually challenges; it does not by itself establish all disaster recovery paths. Guard: A single test can be sufficient for a narrow deterministic question. Generalization needs a justified fault/profile/configuration relationship, not an arbitrary larger test count.

RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

One failover test as proof of disaster recovery

INITIATING_FAILURE

Only nominal fault; shared control survives; secondary warm; no state divergence; no user journey; no return/failback; stale evidence after change. Current limitation: Universal disaster-recovery inference rejected; no rule that every useful claim needs multiple exercises.

RECOVERY_ACTION

Keeps test coverage, state, load and postconditions attached to the claim.

AUTHORITY_SOURCE

State/configuration identity and the actual authority relevant to the action or claim. A pure model has no external action authority; a bounded internal restore does not by itself establish authority to resume a wider service.

CHECKPOINT_BACKUP_SPARE_OR_ALTERNATE

Declared checkpoint, replica, backup, spare, rebuild source or manual workaround.

RPO_OR_STATE_LOSS_BOUND

State/data loss bound where the function depends on preserved state; explicitly state a nontrigger for stateless or directly reconstructible functions.

RTO_OR_RESTORATION_BOUND

The declared restoration interval or bound, if the claim requires one. Distinguish detection, waiting, logistics, repair and validation and avoid summing overlapping intervals.

STATE_RECONCILIATION

Reconcile the state required by the named restored function. Broader divergent or external state may remain an explicit residual; authoritative wider service requires its own relevant conditions.

FUNCTIONAL_POSTCONDITIONS

Recovery across the relevant disaster/fault population, current configuration, representative state/load and postconditions. Current scope: One adequate local test and carefully scoped broader exercises.

DATA_STATE_POSTCONDITIONS

Integrity, completeness, freshness, ordering and authority appropriate to the mission.

DEPENDENCY_POSTCONDITIONS

Verify dependencies that the particular restoration claim requires. Record unverified external dependencies separately; they prevent an unsupported wider completion claim but do not erase a valid internal postcondition.

VALIDATION

An observation or proof adequate to the named functional/state postcondition. Independent end-to-end checks are appropriate when the claim needs them, not a universal prerequisite for every local deterministic restoration.

RETURN_TO_SERVICE_AUTHORITY

Keep proof of the postcondition separate from actual permission to resume consequential service. Name the relevant decision maker or rule when applicable.

ROLLBACK_OR_FALLBACK

A justified bounded fallback where it adds protection. It need not resolve every root cause, and not every restoration claim requires a second full recovery mechanism.

MATURE_FORM

A failover result supports the conditions and faults it actually challenges; it does not by itself establish all disaster recovery paths. Guard: A single test can be sufficient for a narrow deterministic question. Generalization needs a justified fault/profile/configuration relationship, not an arbitrary larger test count.

RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

One failover test as proof of disaster recovery

CLAIM

A failover result supports the conditions and faults it actually challenges; it does not by itself establish all disaster recovery paths. Guard: A single test can be sufficient for a narrow deterministic question. Generalization needs a justified fault/profile/configuration relationship, not an arbitrary larger test count.

POPULATION_OR_DENOMINATOR

Declared units, missions, demands, requests, users, time windows or recurrent-event process.

CONFIGURATION_IDENTITY

Identify the hardware, software, data, model, environment, dependency and procedure conditions that the particular claim materially depends on. An exhaustive live inventory is not universally required.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE

Representative demand/workload/environment with consequence-important rare cases identified.

TEST_OR_OBSERVATION_DESIGN

Use a design adequate to the estimand: sampling, censoring, exposure and stopping assumptions for stochastic inference; an exact predicate and finite domain for a deterministic check. Retrospective observations retain their actual design limits.

MODEL

Model selected for the stated estimand: life distribution, recurrent-event process, binomial demand, availability state model or direct functional check.

ASSUMPTIONS

Declare the assumptions actually used, such as independence, stationarity, censoring, repair effectiveness, acceleration, coverage or representativeness. Their absence from an unrelated deterministic claim is not automatically a defect.

CONFIDENCE_OR_UNCERTAINTY

Express uncertainty appropriate to the claim. A stochastic estimate needs its model and uncertainty; an exact deterministic result need not invent a probability interval. A qualitative criterion may remain qualitative.

CENSORING_AND_MISSINGNESS

Right/interval censoring, unreported events, lost telemetry and excluded windows are recorded.

COVERAGE

Empirical inference is limited by the observed population and design; a mathematical or exhaustive finite result can cover its explicitly proved domain. Neither automatically supplies external-system correspondence.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Retain the tested claim, narrow a broader one or test a material remaining difference.

CHEAP_PATH

Recheck the changed component/path or use existing valid evidence when it settles the question.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE

A stateless worker failover does not test a corrupt backup, stale authority or shared control-plane outage.

EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS

Reassess evidence when a relevant configuration, profile, environment, support or dependency change alters a premise. No arbitrary periodic expiry or full-retest rule follows for unaffected claims.

MATURE_FORM

A failover result supports the conditions and faults it actually challenges; it does not by itself establish all disaster recovery paths. Guard: A single test can be sufficient for a narrow deterministic question. Generalization needs a justified fault/profile/configuration relationship, not an arbitrary larger test count.

profile_scope

The native applicability classification is retained for this candidate claim. Applicable templates describe claim-specific questions, not a mandatory bundle for every system. Nonapplicable reasons remain exact.

PROPERTY_ID

ERM-P048

PROPERTY_NAME

No incidents or lower incident count as proof of reliability improvement

HISTORICAL_ORIGIN

Failure-count/growth tracking and modern incident metrics.

LINEAGE_CLASS

  1. SERVICE_RELIABILITY_OR_SRE_TRANSLATION

  2. RELIABILITY_GROWTH_LINEAGE

RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS

  1. SERVICE_RELIABILITY_TRANSLATION

  2. RELIABILITY_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

ORIGINAL_FORM

Use fewer failures/incidents over time as evidence of improvement.

PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED

Provide a simple trend signal.

REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION

No standalone function is established without exposure, severity, detection/reporting and configuration/profile context.

FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT

Lower demand; hidden/uncaught incidents; severity reclassification; fewer but larger correlated outages; reporting suppression; changed denominator.

MECHANISM

Reject raw count; normalise by exposure/profile, stratify consequence and recurrence family, track latent/near-miss evidence and detection changes.

TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT

Use incident rates only with stable definitions/exposure and as one part of ERM-P024/025/028 evidence.

NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH

For low counts, inspect each failure mechanism and consequence rather than model a trend.

DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS

Event definition, exposure, detection/reporting consistency, severity, configuration and recurrence families.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS

A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS

A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS

No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.

DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS

Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS

No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS

The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF

Limited signal when denominators and ascertainment are stable.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Reliability/service owner and decision authority.

KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES

Goodhart effects; ticket splitting/merging; reporting fear; observation changes; tail hidden by count.

IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS

Incident absence is compatible with latent failure, low exposure or weak detection.

HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED

Raw counts evolved toward exposure-normalised rates, user impact, recurrence and causal corrective-action evidence.

MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM

Treat count as descriptive; claim improvement only with stable exposure, detection and mechanism/impact evidence.

CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY

Incident-count OKR is the ceremony.

reason_codes

  1. ANALYTICAL_REDECOMPOSITION

bearer

Reported incident counts and an improvement claim.

proposition

No incidents or fewer reported incidents can be consistent with low exposure, missing detection, changing severity definitions or chance; counts alone do not prove improved reliability.

guard_quantifier

Descriptive counts are legitimate when their population and observation window are stated. Rate/causal comparisons require relevant exposure, detection and case-mix information.

model_domain

A count is an observation. Risk and intervention effect are different estimands.

mechanism

Prevents underreporting or denominator change from becoming apparent engineering success.

consumer_decision

Inspect mechanisms, normalize exposure, retain uncertainty or investigate a changed reporting process.

positive_scope

Honest count descriptions, low-count case analysis and appropriate statistical comparison.

negative_scope

The universal proof inference is rejected; a higher count does not automatically prove worsening either.

counterexample

C08dropsfrom10to5failures while exposure drops1000to100, so the observed rate increases fivefold.

criterion

Reconcile failure definition, exposure, reporting/ascertainment and concurrent changes before claiming improvement.

evidence_refs

  1. F026

  2. F037

  3. F005

evidence_ceiling

Historical selected reporting, methodology and invented arithmetic; no real pre/post causal study.

remaining_premises

Complete enough observation, comparable opportunities, uncertainty and mechanism evidence.

cheap_path_alternatives

For a few cases, inspect each material mechanism/consequence rather than fitting a fragile trend.

cost_retirement

Avoid incentives to suppress incidents; stop collecting unused headline counts while retaining useful underlying evidence.

audit_question

Could the count change be explained by exposure or observation rather than a real change in failure risk?

RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

No incidents or lower incident count as proof of reliability improvement

CLAIM

No incidents or fewer reported incidents can be consistent with low exposure, missing detection, changing severity definitions or chance; counts alone do not prove improved reliability. Guard: Descriptive counts are legitimate when their population and observation window are stated. Rate/causal comparisons require relevant exposure, detection and case-mix information.

POPULATION_OR_DENOMINATOR

Declared units, missions, demands, requests, users, time windows or recurrent-event process.

CONFIGURATION_IDENTITY

Identify the hardware, software, data, model, environment, dependency and procedure conditions that the particular claim materially depends on. An exhaustive live inventory is not universally required.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE

Representative demand/workload/environment with consequence-important rare cases identified.

TEST_OR_OBSERVATION_DESIGN

Use a design adequate to the estimand: sampling, censoring, exposure and stopping assumptions for stochastic inference; an exact predicate and finite domain for a deterministic check. Retrospective observations retain their actual design limits.

MODEL

Model selected for the stated estimand: life distribution, recurrent-event process, binomial demand, availability state model or direct functional check.

ASSUMPTIONS

Declare the assumptions actually used, such as independence, stationarity, censoring, repair effectiveness, acceleration, coverage or representativeness. Their absence from an unrelated deterministic claim is not automatically a defect.

CONFIDENCE_OR_UNCERTAINTY

Express uncertainty appropriate to the claim. A stochastic estimate needs its model and uncertainty; an exact deterministic result need not invent a probability interval. A qualitative criterion may remain qualitative.

CENSORING_AND_MISSINGNESS

Right/interval censoring, unreported events, lost telemetry and excluded windows are recorded.

COVERAGE

Empirical inference is limited by the observed population and design; a mathematical or exhaustive finite result can cover its explicitly proved domain. Neither automatically supplies external-system correspondence.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Inspect mechanisms, normalize exposure, retain uncertainty or investigate a changed reporting process.

CHEAP_PATH

For a few cases, inspect each material mechanism/consequence rather than fitting a fragile trend.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE

C08dropsfrom10to5failures while exposure drops1000to100, so the observed rate increases fivefold.

EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS

Reassess evidence when a relevant configuration, profile, environment, support or dependency change alters a premise. No arbitrary periodic expiry or full-retest rule follows for unaffected claims.

MATURE_FORM

No incidents or fewer reported incidents can be consistent with low exposure, missing detection, changing severity definitions or chance; counts alone do not prove improved reliability. Guard: Descriptive counts are legitimate when their population and observation window are stated. Rate/causal comparisons require relevant exposure, detection and case-mix information.

profile_scope

The native applicability classification is retained for this candidate claim. Applicable templates describe claim-specific questions, not a mandatory bundle for every system. Nonapplicable reasons remain exact.

PROPERTY_ID

ERM-P049

PROPERTY_NAME

Green health check as proof that required function is available

HISTORICAL_ORIGIN

Built-in test and automated liveness/readiness endpoints.

LINEAGE_CLASS

  1. DIAGNOSTICS_AND_PHM_LINEAGE

  2. SERVICE_RELIABILITY_OR_SRE_TRANSLATION

RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS

  1. MAINTAINABILITY_NATIVE

  2. SERVICE_RELIABILITY_TRANSLATION

ORIGINAL_FORM

Use a green heartbeat or health endpoint to mark an item available.

PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED

Enable rapid automated routing and status display.

REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION

End-to-end required function with correct state, dependencies and performance.

FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT

Probe checks process existence/local loop; dependency/user path fails; monitor stale; partial/cohort failure; latent standby absent.

MECHANISM

Reject equivalence; apply ERM-P011/ERM-P033 layered coverage and end-to-end functional checks.

TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT

A health bit can govern local routing only for the failure modes it demonstrably covers.

NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH

Execute a real safe user/mission transaction.

DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS

Coverage model, representative path, independent monitor and state correctness.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS

A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS

A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS

No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.

DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS

Enumerated fault/failure population, observable signals, calibrated thresholds, isolation resolution, false-alarm and missed-detection costs.

RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS

No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS

The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF

Fast local indication within bounded coverage.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Traffic manager/operator; not a generic mission claimant.

KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES

False green, false red, cached response, monitor shares failure, healthy component unreachable.

IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS

Component alive is not system function; incident evidence is direct.

HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED

One-bit health evolved toward layered symptoms, journeys, state and diagnostic coverage.

MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM

A green signal is labelled with exact coverage and never expanded beyond it.

CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY

The green checkmark is the ceremony.

INITIATING_FAULT_OR_FAILURE

Probe checks process existence/local loop; dependency/user path fails; monitor stale; partial/cohort failure; latent standby absent.

LOCAL_EFFECT

Loss, corruption, delay, false indication or degraded performance at the initiating item.

NEXT_LEVEL_EFFECT

Effect on the enclosing function, dependency path or maintenance process.

END_EFFECT

Probe checks process existence/local loop; dependency/user path fails; monitor stale; partial/cohort failure; latent standby absent.

PROPAGATION_PATH

Functional, physical, state, timing, control, resource or organisational coupling.

CONTAINMENT_BOUNDARY

Coverage model, representative path, independent monitor and state correctness.

COMMON_CAUSE_OR_SHARED_COUPLING

Shared specification, environment, supplier, control plane, state, maintenance or operator path must be challenged.

LATENT_CONDITION

Standby, monitoring, repair or dependency defects may remain latent until demand.

DETECTION

Outcome- or function-relevant observation, not a component heartbeat alone.

CONTROL

Reject equivalence; apply ERM-P011/ERM-P033 layered coverage and end-to-end functional checks.

RESIDUAL_RISK

Unmodelled combinations, dependence, coverage gaps and changed configuration remain.

DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

Green health check as proof that required function is available

TARGET_FAULTS_FAILURES

Probe checks process existence/local loop; dependency/user path fails; monitor stale; partial/cohort failure; latent standby absent.

OBSERVABLES

Function outputs, timing, state, residuals, dependency signals and user/mission outcomes.

DETECTION_COVERAGE

Coverage is stated for an enumerated fault/failure population, operating mode and latency window.

FALSE_ALARM_COST

Unnecessary maintenance, failover, shutdown, operator load or customer disruption.

MISSED_DETECTION_COST

Continued propagation, latent damage, missed recovery window or false assurance.

ISOLATION_RESOLUTION

Replaceable unit, functional region, dependency or ambiguity group appropriate to the action.

AMBIGUITY_GROUPS

Plausible causes producing the same symptom are preserved until discriminated.

LATENCY

Detection and isolation time are bounded relative to propagation and recovery deadlines.

CONFIDENCE_CALIBRATION

Uncertainty, thresholds, drift and out-of-distribution conditions are exposed.

OPERATOR_OR_AUTOMATION_ACTION

Action is authority-bounded, reversible where feasible and matched to diagnosis confidence.

RECOVERY_COVERAGE

A detected fault counts only if the prescribed action restores or contains the target failure with known coverage.

MATURE_FORM

A green signal is labelled with exact coverage and never expanded beyond it.

RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE

RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

Green health check as proof that required function is available

CLAIM

A green signal is labelled with exact coverage and never expanded beyond it.

POPULATION_OR_DENOMINATOR

Declared units, missions, demands, requests, users, time windows or recurrent-event process.

CONFIGURATION_IDENTITY

Exact hardware, software, data, model, dependency and procedure versions.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE

Representative demand/workload/environment with consequence-important rare cases identified.

TEST_OR_OBSERVATION_DESIGN

Predeclared sampling/censoring, failure scoring, exposure and stopping rules.

MODEL

Model selected for the stated estimand: life distribution, recurrent-event process, binomial demand, availability state model or direct functional check.

ASSUMPTIONS

Independence, stationarity, censoring, repair effectiveness, acceleration, coverage and representativeness are explicit.

CONFIDENCE_OR_UNCERTAINTY

Intervals, posterior uncertainty or bounded qualitative confidence; point estimates alone are insufficient.

CENSORING_AND_MISSINGNESS

Right/interval censoring, unreported events, lost telemetry and excluded windows are recorded.

COVERAGE

Claim coverage is limited to tested/observed failure modes, environments and paths.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Traffic manager/operator; not a generic mission claimant.

CHEAP_PATH

Execute a real safe user/mission transaction.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE

For a simple self-contained component, a well-designed functional self-test can be sufficient within its boundary.

EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS

Evidence expires when configuration, profile, environment, support organisation or dependencies materially change.

MATURE_FORM

A green signal is labelled with exact coverage and never expanded beyond it.

DISPOSITION_RATIONALE

Rejected; superseded by coverage-bound layered functional health ERM-P011/ERM-P033.

reason_codes

  1. ANALYTICAL_REDECOMPOSITION

bearer

A green health indicator and the stronger required-function assertion.

proposition

A green signal proves at most its tested predicate under the probe's assumptions; it does not entail all required functionality unless that equivalence is established.

guard_quantifier

A direct complete binary functional test can be adequate for a genuinely binary requirement. Reject only expansion beyond actual coverage.

model_domain

Logical implication from probe predicate to required predicate must be supported; matching labels is insufficient.

mechanism

Exposes semantic gaps between liveness, data access, correctness and consumer completion.

consumer_decision

Use the scoped signal, add a direct check or avoid harmful automatic action.

positive_scope

Precisely labelled health evidence underC033.

negative_scope

Universal green-means-available inference rejected; green signals are not universally uninformative.

counterexample

C14'scheapacceptancepredicatepassesawrongpermutation; C04'slocalstateisvalidbutthewidertransactioncannotcomplete.

criterion

Try a counterexample satisfying the probe but violating the requirement; inspect probe dependencies and error modes.

  1. F043

  2. F017

evidence_ceiling

Primary design/operator accounts plus explicit countermodels, not a production monitoring evaluation.

remaining_premises

Oracle correctness, coverage, current configuration, sampling and observation failure.

cheap_path_alternatives

Perform the relevant safe functional transaction directly.

cost_retirement

Remove redundant indicators with no receiving use; account for probe load and state mutation.

audit_question

Can the indicator be green while the required function fails, and if so which narrower statement is warranted?

COMMON_CAUSE_OR_SHARED_COUPLING

Shared specification, environment, supplier, control plane, state, maintenance or operator path must be challenged.

LATENT_CONDITION

Standby, monitoring, repair or dependency defects may remain latent until demand.

DETECTION

Function-relevant observation at the claimed boundary; a component heartbeat can suffice when it directly observes the complete required binary function. It does not establish a wider end-to-end function merely by being green.

CONTROL

Exposes semantic gaps between liveness, data access, correctness and consumer completion.

RESIDUAL_RISK

Unmodeled combinations, dependence, observation gaps and changed conditions remain possible. A valid bounded containment contribution need not establish diagnosis or complete restoration.

REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

false

PROFILE_TYPE

REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE

REASON

The property does not itself claim redundancy benefit; any redundant implementation must invoke ERM-P008/ERM-P009.

DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

Green health check as proof that required function is available

TARGET_FAULTS_FAILURES

Probe checks process existence/local loop; dependency/user path fails; monitor stale; partial/cohort failure; latent standby absent. Current limitation: Universal green-means-available inference rejected; green signals are not universally uninformative.

OBSERVABLES

Function outputs, timing, state, residuals, dependency signals and user/mission outcomes.

DETECTION_COVERAGE

Coverage is stated for an enumerated fault/failure population, operating mode and latency window.

FALSE_ALARM_COST

Unnecessary maintenance, failover, shutdown, operator load or customer disruption.

MISSED_DETECTION_COST

Continued propagation, latent damage, missed recovery window or false assurance.

ISOLATION_RESOLUTION

Replaceable unit, functional region, dependency or ambiguity group appropriate to the action.

AMBIGUITY_GROUPS

Plausible causes producing the same symptom are preserved until discriminated.

LATENCY

Detection and isolation time are bounded relative to propagation and recovery deadlines.

CONFIDENCE_CALIBRATION

Uncertainty, thresholds, drift and out-of-distribution conditions are exposed.

OPERATOR_OR_AUTOMATION_ACTION

Action is authority-bounded, reversible where feasible and matched to diagnosis confidence.

RECOVERY_COVERAGE

Count a detected event as successfully restored or contained only for the separately declared action outcome and denominator. A true detected event remains detected even when restoration is absent or unresolved. Detection, isolation, containment and restoration coverage are reported separately.

MATURE_FORM

A green signal proves at most its tested predicate under the probe's assumptions; it does not entail all required functionality unless that equivalence is established. Guard: A direct complete binary functional test can be adequate for a genuinely binary requirement. Reject only expansion beyond actual coverage.

RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

false

PROFILE_TYPE

RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE

REASON

No distinct recovery claim is made by this candidate.

RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

Green health check as proof that required function is available

CLAIM

A green signal proves at most its tested predicate under the probe's assumptions; it does not entail all required functionality unless that equivalence is established. Guard: A direct complete binary functional test can be adequate for a genuinely binary requirement. Reject only expansion beyond actual coverage.

POPULATION_OR_DENOMINATOR

Declared units, missions, demands, requests, users, time windows or recurrent-event process.

CONFIGURATION_IDENTITY

Identify the hardware, software, data, model, environment, dependency and procedure conditions that the particular claim materially depends on. An exhaustive live inventory is not universally required.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE

Representative demand/workload/environment with consequence-important rare cases identified.

TEST_OR_OBSERVATION_DESIGN

Use a design adequate to the estimand: sampling, censoring, exposure and stopping assumptions for stochastic inference; an exact predicate and finite domain for a deterministic check. Retrospective observations retain their actual design limits.

MODEL

Model selected for the stated estimand: life distribution, recurrent-event process, binomial demand, availability state model or direct functional check.

ASSUMPTIONS

Declare the assumptions actually used, such as independence, stationarity, censoring, repair effectiveness, acceleration, coverage or representativeness. Their absence from an unrelated deterministic claim is not automatically a defect.

CONFIDENCE_OR_UNCERTAINTY

Express uncertainty appropriate to the claim. A stochastic estimate needs its model and uncertainty; an exact deterministic result need not invent a probability interval. A qualitative criterion may remain qualitative.

CENSORING_AND_MISSINGNESS

Right/interval censoring, unreported events, lost telemetry and excluded windows are recorded.

COVERAGE

Empirical inference is limited by the observed population and design; a mathematical or exhaustive finite result can cover its explicitly proved domain. Neither automatically supplies external-system correspondence.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Use the scoped signal, add a direct check or avoid harmful automatic action.

CHEAP_PATH

Perform the relevant safe functional transaction directly.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE

C14'scheapacceptancepredicatepassesawrongpermutation; C04'slocalstateisvalidbutthewidertransactioncannotcomplete.

EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS

Reassess evidence when a relevant configuration, profile, environment, support or dependency change alters a premise. No arbitrary periodic expiry or full-retest rule follows for unaffected claims.

MATURE_FORM

A green signal proves at most its tested predicate under the probe's assumptions; it does not entail all required functionality unless that equivalence is established. Guard: A direct complete binary functional test can be adequate for a genuinely binary requirement. Reject only expansion beyond actual coverage.

profile_scope

The native applicability classification is retained for this candidate claim. Applicable templates describe claim-specific questions, not a mandatory bundle for every system. Nonapplicable reasons remain exact.

PROPERTY_ID

ERM-P050

PROPERTY_NAME

Chaos exercise as general proof of resilience

HISTORICAL_ORIGIN

Popularisation and branding of chaos engineering.

LINEAGE_CLASS

  1. FAULT_INJECTION_OR_CHAOS_TRANSLATION

RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS

  1. DOMAIN_TRANSLATION

  2. FAULT_TOLERANCE_IMPORT_OR_SHARED_ANCESTRY

ORIGINAL_FORM

Run a fault-injection event and conclude the system is resilient.

PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED

Challenge integrated failure handling.

REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION

No general resilience property follows; evidence is bounded to the hypothesis, fault, profile, boundary, observation and recovery postconditions.

FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT

Toy fault; easy steady-state metric; no state/data validation; unrepresentative load; no correlated failure; no action; survivorship bias.

MECHANISM

Reject ceremony; apply ERM-P035 hypothesis-bound experiments selected by decision value.

TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT

Only when a live uncertainty cannot be resolved more cheaply/safely and experiment controls are adequate.

NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH

Static analysis, simulation, staging or direct functional/recovery test.

DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS

Hypothesis, coverage, containment, observability, abort, representative state/load and decision consumer.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS

A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS

A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS

No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.

DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS

Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS

No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS

The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF

Specific evidence for the tested claim.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Service/mission owner and reliability decision-maker.

KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES

Chaos theatre; production harm; impressive demo; repeated schedule; no denominator; no postconditions.

IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS

The 2025 multivocal review identifies unresolved evaluation/adoption gaps; principles are advocacy, not independent proof.

HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED

Random breakage/“monkey” branding narrowed to controlled, hypothesis-driven, decision-linked experiments.

MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM

Never claim general resilience; publish tested claim, boundaries, observations, recovery validation and resulting decision.

CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY

The named chaos event is the ceremony.

RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

Chaos exercise as general proof of resilience

CLAIM

An exercise is evidence for its tested claim, configuration, fault and observations; exercise branding or completion is not general resilience assurance. Guard: Preserve legitimate confirmations/no-change outcomes. Generalization requires a justified relation to untested conditions and cannot be supplied by exercise frequency alone.

POPULATION_OR_DENOMINATOR

Declared units, missions, demands, requests, users, time windows or recurrent-event process.

CONFIGURATION_IDENTITY

Identify the hardware, software, data, model, environment, dependency and procedure conditions that the particular claim materially depends on. An exhaustive live inventory is not universally required.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE

Representative demand/workload/environment with consequence-important rare cases identified.

TEST_OR_OBSERVATION_DESIGN

Use a design adequate to the estimand: sampling, censoring, exposure and stopping assumptions for stochastic inference; an exact predicate and finite domain for a deterministic check. Retrospective observations retain their actual design limits.

MODEL

Model selected for the stated estimand: life distribution, recurrent-event process, binomial demand, availability state model or direct functional check.

ASSUMPTIONS

Declare the assumptions actually used, such as independence, stationarity, censoring, repair effectiveness, acceleration, coverage or representativeness. Their absence from an unrelated deterministic claim is not automatically a defect.

CONFIDENCE_OR_UNCERTAINTY

Express uncertainty appropriate to the claim. A stochastic estimate needs its model and uncertainty; an exact deterministic result need not invent a probability interval. A qualitative criterion may remain qualitative.

CENSORING_AND_MISSINGNESS

Right/interval censoring, unreported events, lost telemetry and excluded windows are recorded.

COVERAGE

Empirical inference is limited by the observed population and design; a mathematical or exhaustive finite result can cover its explicitly proved domain. Neither automatically supplies external-system correspondence.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Retain/narrow a claim, fix a discovered issue, stop an unsafe experiment or use a cheaper discriminator.

CHEAP_PATH

Static reasoning, replay, staging or direct functional/recovery testing.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE

Repeatedly injecting a familiar worker loss says little about stale state or a coordinated configuration defect; no action may correctly follow a successful discriminating test.

EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS

Reassess evidence when a relevant configuration, profile, environment, support or dependency change alters a premise. No arbitrary periodic expiry or full-retest rule follows for unaffected claims.

MATURE_FORM

An exercise is evidence for its tested claim, configuration, fault and observations; exercise branding or completion is not general resilience assurance. Guard: Preserve legitimate confirmations/no-change outcomes. Generalization requires a justified relation to untested conditions and cannot be supplied by exercise frequency alone.

profile_scope

The native applicability classification is retained for this candidate claim. Applicable templates describe claim-specific questions, not a mandatory bundle for every system. Nonapplicable reasons remain exact.

PROPERTY_ID

ERM-P051

PROPERTY_NAME

More redundancy always improves reliability

HISTORICAL_ORIGIN

Parallel RBD arithmetic and fault-tolerance intuition.

LINEAGE_CLASS

  1. HARDWARE_RELIABILITY_LINEAGE

  2. FAULT_TOLERANT_COMPUTING_LINEAGE

RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS

  1. RELIABILITY_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

  2. FAULT_TOLERANCE_IMPORT_OR_SHARED_ANCESTRY

ORIGINAL_FORM

Add copies/paths so independent joint failure becomes less likely.

PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED

Reduce random component failure probability.

REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION

Improved mission outcome after specified faults, not increased component count.

FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT

Common cause, voter/switch fault, dormant spare, state split, capacity/overload, maintenance complexity, update concentration or new interfaces dominate.

MECHANISM

Reject monotonic slogan; apply ERM-P008/009/040 and compare total system reliability/maintainability under dependence and coverage.

TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT

Add redundancy only when failure modes, domains, coverage, state and lifecycle burden support positive net value.

NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH

Simplify/eliminate the failure cause, add a manual spare, improve repair, or accept risk when redundancy burden exceeds benefit.

DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS

Common-cause model, transfer coverage, capacity/state, maintenance/support and evidence.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS

A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS

A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS

Credible failure-domain independence, common-cause analysis, standby condition, switchover coverage and state compatibility.

DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS

Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS

No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS

The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF

Can be large under valid independence; can be negative otherwise.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Architect and mission/risk authority.

KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES

Shared power/control/specification; hidden standby; complexity; simultaneous maintenance; false failover; correlated release.

IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS

Formal and empirical literature directly show dependence can destroy the multiplicative benefit.

HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED

Copy-count reasoning evolved toward failure-domain, coverage, diversity, state and supportability cases.

MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM

No redundancy claim without a total-system conditional argument and cheaper-path comparison.

CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY

The N+1/TMR diagram is the ceremony when assumptions are unstated.

REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

How should engineering teams quantify negative reliability from operational complexity before deployment?

COVERAGE

Architect and mission/risk authority.

CHEAP_PATH

Independent, observable, maintainable redundancy remains one of the strongest reliability mechanisms.

EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS

Evidence expires when configuration, profile, environment, support organisation or dependencies materially change.

No redundancy claim without a total-system conditional argument and cheaper-path comparison.

DISPOSITION_RATIONALE

Universal monotonic claim rejected; conditional redundancy retained as ERM-P008/ERM-P009/ERM-P040.

disposition

RETAIN_REJECTION_OF_MONOTONE_ARCHITECTURE

reason_codes

  1. ANALYTICAL_REDECOMPOSITION

bearer

An architecture change adding replicas, voters, transfer or synchronization.

proposition

Adding redundancy need not improve whole-system reliability because new failure paths, common causes and burdens can outweigh rescue cases.

guard_quantifier

Ideal monotone OR addition cannot reduce success when it introduces no interactions or losses. Real additions can violate that guard. Dependence alone does not imply negative benefit.

model_domain

Distinguish monotonicity of a fixed mathematical structure from changed-system behavior.

mechanism

Compares rescue events with added losses instead of counting copies.

consumer_decision

Add, simplify, isolate, improve repair or accept downtime.

positive_scope

Legitimate beneficial redundancy, including under dependence, underC009.

negative_scope

'More always improves' rejected; 'all redundancy is harmful' also unsupported.

counterexample

C02'sdependentpairimproves.90to.91,butaddinga.95reliabilityserialcontrollergives.8645.

criterion

Account for both protected faults and added mechanisms, state/capacity and lifecycle cost.

evidence_refs

  1. F003

  2. F010

  3. F045

evidence_ceiling

Exact stipulated joint-event arithmetic plus historical experiment/model literature; no estimate for a real design.

remaining_premises

Joint failure law, actual rescue and added-harm events, controller coverage and cost.

cheap_path_alternatives

Remove a cause, improve one component/repair, use a manual spare or accept a bounded outage.

cost_retirement

Retire an added layer whose burden exceeds its current protected set; preserve evidence for the remaining function.

audit_question

What new ways to fail were added along with the rescue path, and does the total conditional argument still favor it?

cases

  1. C02

change_note

Original rejection retained, with the independence/benefit distinction corrected consistently.

NEXT_LEVEL_EFFECT

END_EFFECT

COMMON_CAUSE_OR_SHARED_COUPLING

Shared specification, environment, supplier, control plane, state, maintenance or operator path must be challenged.

LATENT_CONDITION

Standby, monitoring, repair or dependency defects may remain latent until demand.

DETECTION

Function-relevant observation at the claimed boundary; a component heartbeat can suffice when it directly observes the complete required binary function. It does not establish a wider end-to-end function merely by being green.

PROPERTY

REDUNDANCY_FORM

Active, standby, voting, diverse, replicated or alternate-path redundancy as explicitly declared.

CLAIMED_TOLERANCE

The specified number/class of faults tolerated while meeting required function or an accepted degraded state.

FAILURE_DOMAINS

Physical, power, network, control-plane, state, software, supplier, operator and maintenance domains.

INDEPENDENCE_EVIDENCE

Address actual shared causes and the joint event law. Statistical independence is required only by formulas or claims that use it; dependent paths may still provide a positive rescue increment. Copy count or labels alone do not establish separation.

COMMON_CAUSE_COUPLINGS

Specification, design, implementation, environment, supplier, maintenance, configuration and operational coupling.

STANDBY_LATENCY_OR_DORMANCY

STATE_CONSISTENCY

The takeover state and authority must be current, complete and semantically valid.

DEGRADED_MODE

Declared reduced capability and exit conditions.

TEST_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE

Evidence appropriate to the stated protection claim, including a direct deterministic result or a model at its exact premises where adequate. A general architecture or field-rate claim needs correspondingly broader evidence; no universal live-test or field-study bundle is imposed.

RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE
APPLICABLE

true

PROPERTY

More redundancy always improves reliability

CLAIM

Adding redundancy need not improve whole-system reliability because new failure paths, common causes and burdens can outweigh rescue cases. Guard: Ideal monotone OR addition cannot reduce success when it introduces no interactions or losses. Real additions can violate that guard. Dependence alone does not imply negative benefit.

POPULATION_OR_DENOMINATOR

Declared units, missions, demands, requests, users, time windows or recurrent-event process.

CONFIGURATION_IDENTITY

Identify the hardware, software, data, model, environment, dependency and procedure conditions that the particular claim materially depends on. An exhaustive live inventory is not universally required.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE

Representative demand/workload/environment with consequence-important rare cases identified.

TEST_OR_OBSERVATION_DESIGN

Use a design adequate to the estimand: sampling, censoring, exposure and stopping assumptions for stochastic inference; an exact predicate and finite domain for a deterministic check. Retrospective observations retain their actual design limits.

MODEL

Model selected for the stated estimand: life distribution, recurrent-event process, binomial demand, availability state model or direct functional check.

ASSUMPTIONS

Declare the assumptions actually used, such as independence, stationarity, censoring, repair effectiveness, acceleration, coverage or representativeness. Their absence from an unrelated deterministic claim is not automatically a defect.

CONFIDENCE_OR_UNCERTAINTY

Express uncertainty appropriate to the claim. A stochastic estimate needs its model and uncertainty; an exact deterministic result need not invent a probability interval. A qualitative criterion may remain qualitative.

CENSORING_AND_MISSINGNESS

Right/interval censoring, unreported events, lost telemetry and excluded windows are recorded.

COVERAGE

Empirical inference is limited by the observed population and design; a mathematical or exhaustive finite result can cover its explicitly proved domain. Neither automatically supplies external-system correspondence.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Add, simplify, isolate, improve repair or accept downtime.

CHEAP_PATH

Remove a cause, improve one component/repair, use a manual spare or accept a bounded outage.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE

C02'sdependentpairimproves.90to.91,butaddinga.95reliabilityserialcontrollergives.8645.

EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS

Reassess evidence when a relevant configuration, profile, environment, support or dependency change alters a premise. No arbitrary periodic expiry or full-retest rule follows for unaffected claims.

MATURE_FORM

Adding redundancy need not improve whole-system reliability because new failure paths, common causes and burdens can outweigh rescue cases. Guard: Ideal monotone OR addition cannot reduce success when it introduces no interactions or losses. Real additions can violate that guard. Dependence alone does not imply negative benefit.

profile_scope

The native applicability classification is retained for this candidate claim. Applicable templates describe claim-specific questions, not a mandatory bundle for every system. Nonapplicable reasons remain exact.

PROPERTY_ID

ERM-P052

PROPERTY_NAME

Predictive maintenance universally outperforms simpler policies

HISTORICAL_ORIGIN

Industry 4.0/AI predictive-maintenance promotion.

LINEAGE_CLASS

  1. DIAGNOSTICS_AND_PHM_LINEAGE

  2. DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS

  1. MAINTAINABILITY_NATIVE

  2. DOMAIN_TRANSLATION

ORIGINAL_FORM

Use sensors and ML/RUL prediction to replace scheduled or reactive maintenance.

PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED

Reduce unexpected failure and unnecessary scheduled work.

REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION

Lower mission/lifecycle loss than feasible alternatives under actual failure mechanisms and action constraints.

FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT

No precursor; weak labels; domain shift; false alarms; late warning; costly sensor stack; maintenance action itself harmful; benchmark not prospective.

MECHANISM

Reject universality; use ERM-P023 comparative, uncertainty-aware, mechanism- and decision-valid assessment.

TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT

Only for observable degradation with lead time and effective intervention.

NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH

Run-to-failure, inspection or scheduled maintenance when net performance is comparable.

DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS

Sensors, data, transfer, uncertainty, lead time, intervention efficacy and loss comparison.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS

A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS

A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS

No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.

DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS

Enumerated fault/failure population, observable signals, calibrated thresholds, isolation resolution, false-alarm and missed-detection costs.

RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS

No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS

Access, modularity, safe isolation, procedures, test equipment, spares, tools, skills, logistics, configuration data and time under actual field conditions.

EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF

Potentially high in suitable mechanisms; absent or negative elsewhere.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Asset owner and maintenance planner.

KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES

AI hype; accuracy metric not decision value; false work orders; missed failure; model maintenance burden.

IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS

Systematic reviews show heterogeneous evidence; current uncertainty review rejects certainty in RUL deployment.

HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED

Universal automation claims narrowed toward hybrid/uncertainty-aware and decision-comparative PHM.

MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM

No “PdM is better” claim without prospective comparison to the cheapest credible policy.

CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY

The platform/digital twin/RUL dashboard is ceremony without demonstrated decision payoff.

OPERATIONAL_PROFILE

MODEL

ASSUMPTIONS

Independence, stationarity, censoring, repair effectiveness, acceleration, coverage and representativeness are explicit.

CONFIDENCE_OR_UNCERTAINTY

Intervals, posterior uncertainty or bounded qualitative confidence; point estimates alone are insufficient.

CENSORING_AND_MISSINGNESS

Right/interval censoring, unreported events, lost telemetry and excluded windows are recorded.

COVERAGE

Claim coverage is limited to tested/observed failure modes, environments and paths.

DECISION_OR_CONSUMER

Asset owner and maintenance planner.

CHEAP_PATH

Run-to-failure, inspection or scheduled maintenance when net performance is comparable.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE

Specific well-instrumented degradation mechanisms support effective PdM.

EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS

Evidence expires when configuration, profile, environment, support organisation or dependencies materially change.

MATURE_FORM

No “PdM is better” claim without prospective comparison to the cheapest credible policy.

reason_codes

bearer

A claimed universal advantage of predictive maintenance over feasible alternatives.

proposition

Predictive maintenance is not universally superior; a benefit claim must compare its whole policy consequences with credible simpler policies at the relevant scope.

guard_quantifier

Use evidence adequate to the claim: prospective comparative field evidence is strong for deployed utility, but conditional analytical comparisons or well-qualified observational evidence can support narrower decisions. Do not impose prospective trials on every bounded claim.

model_domain

Predictive error and maintenance-policy value are different; a conditional optimum inherits its loss function and feasible policy set.

mechanism

Rejects a technology preference that ignores false actions, precursor absence and upkeep.

consumer_decision

Use, pilot, narrow or decline a predictive policy.

positive_scope

Specific justified PdM improvements underC023.

negative_scope

Universal superiority rejected; lack of a trial is not proof of no possible benefit.

counterexample

C03showsfalse-actioncostcaneraseinformationvalue; C05showsa simpleagepolicymayworkwellforaselectedwear-outmodel.

criterion

State comparator, intervention opportunity, costs, uncertainty, external validity and what kind of comparison was actually performed.

evidence_refs

  1. F021

  2. F032

  3. F020

evidence_ceiling

Scoped review, publisher abstract and qualitative NIST evidence; no universal comparative outcome or new field study.

remaining_premises

Labels, action feasibility, full costs, drift, selection and causality.

cheap_path_alternatives

Run to failure, inspection or scheduled maintenance when adequate and less burdensome.

cost_retirement

Include model/data integration and continuing validation; retire unsupported automation without discarding useful observations.

audit_question

Better than which feasible policy, for which loss and population, on what actual comparative evidence?

cases

change_note

Preserves rejection but narrows native unconditional prospective-comparison wording to the strength of claim warranted.
